about: EVERYTHING HIS PAGE SAYS that is not a record (the rebuild, 2026-10-21): the page's own name, caption, title and what it measures, what each part of him is called and is, his card's price word. Read by agent.shared_where.page() together with settings.json's 'page' and routes.json; nothing here is a setting.

page.name: SCRUM MASTER SUPER AGENT HARNESS
page.caption: The daily cycle
page.title: SCRUM MASTER SUPER AGENT HARNESS
page.measures: Every step of the day's cycle, as the SCRUM MASTER's own record of that day holds it: checked, reported, fixed and run again where it broke, reported closed. A step not seen is counted as not seen, never as green.
page.card_about: HIS CARD (the owner 2026-10-13: "on the very top on the left of the description ... add a card just like the agent cards in the agent marketplace this will give it a personality"): settings is his own settings file, whose card holds his card's values and his picture; his card's maker (that card's maker key: the agents' marketplace card maker), asked for that one card exactly as the marketplace asks it (web/page.card); an office names no product of ours (LRYLLM STANDS ALONE). No toggle on it: he is internal and always on (the owner 2026-10-21: "we dont need a hire its internal and always on"), the card a picture.

under_parts.scrum_master: His office: how it is set up and its lock.
under_parts.scrum_master/app: His app: the agent (agent), his page and its host (web), his picture (static) and his settings (schemas).
under_parts.scrum_master/instance: His own data: his database. The only part the lock leaves open.

page.under_parts_about: WHAT EACH PART OF HIM IS, one plain sentence a row of the table under the three boxes (the owner 2026-10-19: a chart "very easy to read and see and understand"): key = the piece, or piece/folder, as the locked folder has it; a part with no sentence shows its files alone
page.under_names_about: WHAT EACH PART IS CALLED in the table under the warning (the owner 2026-10-19: two rows both said SCRUM_MASTER, "call it ... settings"): key as under_parts; a part with no name here shows its folder's
page.card_price_about: THE WORD IN HIS CARD'S PRICE PLACE (the owner 2026-10-19: "Free to internal"): LARRYD's maker says Free for a card with no rate; he is no marketplace agent, so his page says this instead
